title: Cosmic Duck Oracle
description: A black silhouette of a woman in profile with closed eyes and flowing purple and green galaxy hair dominates the right side. In the center, a glowing purple circular portal contains a stylized green duck floating within swirling cosmic patterns. The dark background features white line-art flowers at the bottom, a crescent moon, stars, a purple butterfly, a small castle, a mountain, a planet with rings, and a hanging scale.
prompt: Surreal cosmic portrait of a black female silhouette in profile with eyes closed, her long flowing hair made of purple and green galaxies, stars, and nebulae. A glowing purple circular portal in the center contains a stylized green duck floating inside. Dark background with white line art flowers at the bottom, crescent moons, a small castle, mountain, butterfly, planet with rings, and a hanging scale. Mystical night sky atmosphere, intricate line work, vibrant cosmic colors.
